text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket looks worse for wear after
her anxiety-filled exit from
public training.

She must be shocked about it more than
anyone. But with no remedy, things
continue like this until the Derby is
only a
few days away.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Being broadcast live on TV is really
nerve-racking. I can't mess up like
I did at
the Satsuki Sho prerace press conference.

There's a press conference today for the
runners who are participating
in the Derby.

She watches the other athletes on TV,
waiting until she's called in for
her turn.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Um... A little...

She sounds hesitant as she keeps her eyes
on the television.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
The Derby this year is full of strong
contenders. Tell us how you feel
about
that.

text_block_list.name: Racer
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I've been keeping an eye on all
my rivals and how they race. So I
understand that they all have serious
skills
on the track.

text_block_list.name: Racer
text_block_list.text:
But I've finally made it to this
once-in-a-lifetime race. All I'm thinking

about is taking the lead and crossing the
finish line.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Wow, she knows how to keep her eyes on
the prize. I can tell she
means it too.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I think I'll say that I've always
dreamed of
this race—that I'm going to
win it and
become a Derby champion.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
But... that's not how I really feel. I'm
actually terrified of losing.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, sorry for being wishy-washy. I'm
just no good at this.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Everyone else is saying how much they
want to win the Derby, but I'm
probably
the only one this scared.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I can barely feel my legs.
It's like they're
not mine or something.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
You're right. No one's more scared than
you are right now.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
You're right. No one's more scared than
you are right now.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha,
I knew it. If I go out there like this,
they'll all laugh at me.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm not gonna win the Derby.
It's better if I
just qui—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh? I can?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
What're you saying?! Even you admitted it!
I'm way more scared than
anyone else! I'm
the weakest runner here...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: That's exactly why you can win!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: That's exactly why you can win!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That ridiculous! Only a loser squirms in
their shoes at such an
important race!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
The reason why you're more scared than
anyone else is because you
want to win the
Derby more than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
The reason why you're more scared than
anyone else is because you
want to win the
Derby more than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Your legs are shaking just thinking about
losing. No one is this serious
about wanting
to win it.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
My mentor said it too. "That long-held
dream is a strength that will
serve her well
in the Derby."

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
You've wanted it longer than anyone. Ever
since you saw the race with
your own eyes
when you were a kid!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
You've wanted it longer than anyone. Ever
since you saw the race with
your own eyes
when you were a kid!
I hold up her Derby notebook.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Oh... My notebook.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
When you've got nothing left, the weight
of your dream is going to push you
forward—past everyone who doesn't want
this as
desperately as you!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
The weight of my dream... pushes me
forward...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
And then you're going to write it down in
this notebook.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
And then you're going to write it down in
this notebook.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Sob... The Derby... The thing I've wanted my entire life!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I wanna win! It's always been my dream!
I'm
scared, but I can't quit
now!
URAAAAAGH!

As usual, she has to yell through tears
when talking about the Derby.

When I hear her cry echoing out down the
halls, I know it—Winning
Ticket is back.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Whoo! That was a good cry! I mean, I'm always crying, but that was an especially good one, hehe.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Do you know what you want to say to the
reporters?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm terrified about losing, but my will to
win is as great as my fear!
After all, I've
got a big dream to fulfill!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Right! Now I'm really raring to go!
DEEERBYYYYY!
Knock, knock, knock...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to intrude. Winning Ticket,
you're up
next.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Okay! I'm ready for it!

As she and Tazuna make to leave, we hear
a familiar name from the
TV.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: All right, next we have Narita Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's Taishin! Sorry, Ms. Tazuna! Can
you wait just a minute?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Very well, just one minute...

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
It looks like you've been training very
hard, Ms. Taishin. You don't
seem to let
up, even after winning the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Of course. My opponents aren't sitting
quiet after they lost the
Satsuki Sho. So I
can't take it easy either.
I won't let this slip by me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
The only thing my rivals are going to
see in
the Derby is my back.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Taishin's definitely going to be bringing
her A game again.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Taishin's definitely going to be bringing
her A game again.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Sure,
but I'll be the one in front this time!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Moving on, here is Biwa Hayahide.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide! Ms. Tazuna, just one more
minute!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
What?! But you're on immediately after
her!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
She's an Umamusume. She can get there in
an instant!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Not you too! This is live television!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I was able to make it to the Derby due in
no small part to the
existence of my rivals.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
When my peers got one step ahead, I
strove to take two. In doing so,
we pushed
each other forward to make it here.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
However,
simply being in the race isn't the
goal. My aim is to race
against my rivals
and win.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hehehe, let's do it, Hayahide!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'll run like never before!
Our Derby
is going to be the greatest
Derby ever!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Now that my mind's made up, I have to get
moving right this moment!
Super sorry, Ms.
Tazuna, but I'm skipping the press
conference!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! S-stop right there, Winning
Ticket!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, she needs to be at peak
performance, so there's no time to
spare.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: You couldn't have told me that sooner?!

Winning Ticket runs off once again, but
this time, it's toward the
Derby.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Uwaaaaagh! Faster! Faster, faster!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
So that's why she didn't come to the
conference—she was running.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes, but... why is she running in her
uniform?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that's just the way she is. When it
comes to the Derby,
nothing'll stop her
from running.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'M GONNA WIIIN! DEEEEERBYYYYY!

Her pure passion for the Derby can be
heard in her resounding
footsteps as she
blasts toward the racetrack.
